notes: v219 — CONNECT-DELETE-CROSS-ACCOUNT (owner's report, Oct 21, 2026 20:23 MDT: connections removed while signed into the TESTER account vanished from his MAIN account on the same phone — 'I DELETED MY CONNECTIONS IN TESTER ACCOUNT... IT DELETED MY CONNECTIONS HERE IN MY MAIN ACCOUNT?'; verified in his hands Oct 22, 08:21 MDT: main showed Current connections (1) while the backend held all three accepted pairs). Root cause, proven by code read + Firebase Console reads (Oct 22): Firestore requests docs are never deleted (rules forbid it) — 'Remove connection' only edited LOCAL state (splice con_list, record the peer in con_hidden), and the device-local store was ONE slot shared by every account on the phone: v216 uid-namespaced only the profile record, not the Connect keys, so CloudSync's per-key merge carried one session's edits into another account's cloud tree and reconcile refused to resurrect locally-hidden pairs. THE FIX (js/app.js + js/cloudsync.js only): the Connect-local family — con_list, con_hidden, con_outbox, pipe_landed, pipe_seen, nav_shares, cp_hist_peers, and the internal __peer_wages cache — is stored under a PHYSICAL key carrying its owner's uid (con_list__<uid>, 'local' when signed out), following the v216 profile-ownership discipline. The base store translates logical->physical, so every reader/writer (connectlive, connect module, connectpipe, pnl) is unchanged; CloudSync keys its sync meta by the physical key, so the kv doc carries the same namespacing — a removal or hide made in account A's session is physically incapable of landing in account B's namespace, on-device or in the cloud. Migration on first touch per account: the pre-fix shared slot seeds an account's namespace ONLY when attributable to it — attribution reads the previous sync owner's snapshot captured at the v216 auth gate before the session's own pull/push can re-stamp it; otherwise the account's own cloud copy seeds it raw from the pull, ahead of reconcile. con_hidden NEVER seeds from the shared slot (a hide recorded in another account's session must not suppress this account's pairs; his own hides reach him from his own cloud tree). Accepted requests docs still materialize the list on reconcile exactly as before; pair shapes, kinds, modules, the v207 picker and send flows are untouched. New suite tools/connect-namespace-v219-test.js (27/27): boots the real cloudsync + connectlive + app over the owner's exact fixture — the shared slot polluted by a tester session (con_list shrunk to the tester pair, con_hidden holding Umar + Maria), sync meta naming the tester, main's complete cloud tree, the three real accepted docs — main's list rebuilds to self + Umar + tester + Maria (Maria's modules healed to her doc's four), no foreign hide lands, pushes write only namespaced docs; main then removes Maria in HIS session and it sticks across reconcile; the tester session keeps ONLY his own pair and his own hides, and switching back to main shows the tester pair intact with Maria hidden by main's OWN hide only; signed-out sees an empty local namespace. Full suite (143 files): the only failures are the four proven failing identically on a pristine v218 HEAD worktree — boss-firstrun, connect-pipe, role-package, pti-dash-v187 — parked by name, NOT this change. Standing pin move 218 -> 219 across index.html and the test files. MACHINE-SIDE PREPARATION ONLY: the owner's in-hands verdict after this update is the proof.
